title: Bringing closure to theory combination properties
summary: We consider the closure of three classical combination properties, namely, stable infiniteness, gentleness and shininess (or, equivalently for decidable theories, strong politeness), under intersection and combinability. We compute every possible intersection, and then compute the maximal set of theories that can be combined with each resulting intersection. We iterate this process until no new sets are identified. How many properties will we end up with?
